en: Colorized view of a hilltop fortress with multiple red-roofed towers above a village and forested slopes at dusk. People in traditional clothing walk near a wooden bridge in the foreground. Captions read "Bran" and "Castelul Regal." The reverse is a Romanian divided back with address lines, the heading "România," postal-rate note, publisher credit from Bran, and the year 1933.
